pyrolysis process where non-food feedstock like palm biomass waste is used as feedstock. Upon fulfilling UN’s (United Nations)
ACM 22 protocol as well as LCA (Life Cycle Assessment) requirements, it is anticipated that the by-products from this IP would lead to
certification and issuance of Carbon Avoidance Credits as well as Carbon Removal Credits to generate carbon revenue for the Company.
